title: RNA-seq of the three anatomical regions (reflected, placental and umbilical) of the amniotic membrane in the fetal annexes at term
description: Identify differentially expressed genes between the different anatomical regions of the human amnion tissue (placental amnion, reflected amnion, and umbilical amnion).

samples.title: Placental_Amnion_1
samples.description: Protocols: Human fetal membranes were obtained from uncomplicated full-term pregnancies (37–40 weeks gestation) delivered via cesarean section, excluding any cases with active labor, premature rupture of membranes, or signs of chorioamnionitis or genital tract infections. Written informed consent was obtained, along with ethical approval from the responsible institutional committee. The amniotic tissue was transported from the operating theater to the laboratory in a sterile container with saline solution. Under sterile conditions, the amnion was mechanically peeled from the underlying chorion, washed repeatedly with saline to remove blood and clots, and then dissected into three distinct anatomical regions: reflected amnion, placental amnion, and umbilical amnion. Total RNA was isolated from both tissue samples and cultured cells using TRIzol reagent (Life Technologies) according to the manufacturer’s instructions. The extracted and reverse-transcribed cDNA was processed using the Illumina TruSeq RNA Sample Preparation Kit.
attributes: human amniotic epithelial cells isolated from placental amnion
